q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: I did not know that she ___ ill.

explanation.en: The verb in the subordinate clause shifts to the past: was.
explanation.as: অধীন উপবাক্যৰ ক্ৰিয়া অতীতলৈ সলনি হয়: was।

q.en: Choose the correct form: If it ___ tomorrow, we shall stay at home.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: If it ___ tomorrow, we shall stay at home.

explanation.en: In a first conditional, the if-clause takes the simple present rains.
explanation.as: প্ৰথম চৰ্তবাচক বাক্যত if-উপবাক্যই সাধাৰণ বৰ্তমান rains লয়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: If I ___ rich, I would travel.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: If I ___ rich, I would travel.

explanation.en: In an unreal conditional, the if-clause takes were.
explanation.as: অবাস্তৱ চৰ্তবাচক বাক্যত if-উপবাক্যই were লয়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: She has been ill ___ Monday.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: She has been ill ___ Monday.

explanation.en: Since is used with a point of time such as Monday.
explanation.as: Since এসময়ৰ বিন্দুৰ সৈতে ব্যৱহাৰ হয়, যেনে Monday।

q.en: Choose the correct form: I have known him ___ ten years.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: I have known him ___ ten years.

explanation.en: For is used with a period of time such as ten years.
explanation.as: For এসময়ৰ কালছোৱাৰ সৈতে ব্যৱহাৰ হয়, যেনে ten years।

q.en: The rule of sequence of tenses requires that —
q.as: কাল-ক্ৰমৰ নিয়মে দাবী কৰে যে —

options.en: a past main verb takes a past subordinate verb
options.as: অতীত মূল ক্ৰিয়াই অতীত অধীন ক্ৰিয়া লয়

explanation.en: A past main clause is normally followed by a past subordinate clause.
explanation.as: এটা অতীত মূল উপবাক্যৰ পিছত সাধাৰণতে অতীত অধীন উপবাক্য আহে।

q.en: Choose the correct form: He said that he ___ come the next day.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: He said that he ___ come the next day.

explanation.en: Will changes to would after a past reporting verb.
explanation.as: অতীত ৰিপৰ্টিং ক্ৰিয়াৰ পিছত will ৰ সলনি would হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: She ___ TV when I entered.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: She ___ TV when I entered.

explanation.en: The past continuous was watching shows the action in progress when another happened.
explanation.as: অতীত ঘটা was watching এ দেখুৱায় আন এটা ঘটাৰ সময়ত ক্ৰিয়া চলি আছিল।

q.en: Choose the correct form: The boys ___ their homework now.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: The boys ___ their homework now.

explanation.en: Now with a plural subject takes are doing.
explanation.as: এতিয়া বহুবচন কৰ্তাৰ সৈতে are doing লয়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: He ___ in this school since 2015.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: He ___ in this school since 2015.

explanation.en: Since 2015 with a continuing action takes has been teaching.
explanation.as: since 2015 য়ে চলি থকা ক্ৰিয়াৰ সৈতে has been teaching লয়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: We ___ the project by next month.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: We ___ the project by next month.

explanation.en: By next month signals the future perfect shall have finished.
explanation.as: by next month য়ে পূৰ্ণ ভৱিষ্যত shall have finished সূচায়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: She ___ the piano every evening.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: She ___ the piano every evening.

explanation.en: Every evening with she takes the simple present plays.
explanation.as: প্ৰতি সন্ধিয়া she ৰ সৈতে সাধাৰণ বৰ্তমান plays লয়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: They ___ to the fair yesterday.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: They ___ to the fair yesterday.

explanation.en: Yesterday signals the simple past went.
explanation.as: yesterday য়ে সাধাৰণ অতীত went সূচায়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: I ___ him at the station tomorrow.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: I ___ him at the station tomorrow.

explanation.en: Tomorrow with I takes the simple future shall meet.
explanation.as: কালি I ৰ সৈতে সাধাৰণ ভৱিষ্যত shall meet লয়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: By the time we arrived, the film ___.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: By the time we arrived, the film ___.

explanation.en: The earlier past action takes had started.
explanation.as: আগৰ অতীত ক্ৰিয়াৰ বাবে had started লয়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: She usually ___ up early.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: She usually ___ up early.

explanation.en: Usually with she takes the simple present gets.
explanation.as: সাধাৰণতে she ৰ সৈতে সাধাৰণ বৰ্তমান gets লয়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: Look, the train ___ now.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: Look, the train ___ now.

explanation.en: Now with Look takes the present continuous is arriving.
explanation.as: Look ৰ সৈতে now য়ে বৰ্তমান ঘটা is arriving লয়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: He ___ his dinner before I came.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: He ___ his dinner before I came.

explanation.en: The past perfect had eaten shows the earlier completed action.
explanation.as: পূৰ্ণ অতীত had eaten এ আগতে সম্পন্ন ক্ৰিয়া দেখুৱায়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: We ___ for the result since morning.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: We ___ for the result since morning.

explanation.en: Since morning with a continuing action takes have been waiting.
explanation.as: since morning য়ে চলি থকা ক্ৰিয়াৰ সৈতে have been waiting লয়।

q.en: The correct tense form of 'He ___ (finish) the work already' is —
q.as: 'He ___ (finish) the work already' ৰ শুদ্ধ কাল ৰূপ —

explanation.en: Already signals the present perfect has finished.
explanation.as: already য়ে পূৰ্ণ বৰ্তমান has finished সূচায়।

q.en: The correct tense form of 'She ___ (write) a letter when I saw her' is —
q.as: 'She ___ (write) a letter when I saw her' ৰ শুদ্ধ কাল ৰূপ —

explanation.en: The past continuous was writing shows the action in progress.
explanation.as: অতীত ঘটা was writing এ চলি থকা ক্ৰিয়া দেখুৱায়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: He ___ not finished the work yet.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: He ___ not finished the work yet.

explanation.en: With he, the present perfect negative uses has not.
explanation.as: he ৰ সৈতে পূৰ্ণ বৰ্তমানৰ ঋণাত্মক ৰূপত has not লয়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: They ___ arrived by 6 pm.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: They ___ arrived by 6 pm.

explanation.en: By 6 pm signals the future perfect will have arrived.
explanation.as: by 6 pm য়ে পূৰ্ণ ভৱিষ্যত will have arrived সূচায়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: When I reached home, my mother ___.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: When I reached home, my mother ___.

explanation.en: The past continuous was cooking shows the action in progress at a past moment.
explanation.as: অতীত ঘটা was cooking এ অতীত মুহূৰ্তত চলি থকা ক্ৰিয়া দেখুৱায়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: I ___ my homework before dinner.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: I ___ my homework before dinner.

explanation.en: The past perfect had completed shows the earlier action.
explanation.as: পূৰ্ণ অতীত had completed এ আগৰ ক্ৰিয়া দেখুৱায়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: She ___ the truth, but nobody believed her.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: She ___ the truth, but nobody believed her.

explanation.en: The past narrative takes the simple past told.
explanation.as: অতীতৰ আখ্যানে সাধাৰণ অতীত told লয়।

q.en: Choose the correct form: The children ___ in the park every Sunday.
q.as: শুদ্ধ ৰূপ বাছনি কৰা: The children ___ in the park every Sunday.

explanation.en: Every Sunday with a plural subject takes the simple present play.
explanation.as: প্ৰতি দেওবাৰ বহুবচন কৰ্তাৰ সৈতে সাধাৰণ বৰ্তমান play লয়।
